title: Career Roadmap · Salon Owner
summary: A Salon Owner establishes and manages a beauty or hair salon, overseeing services, staff, hygiene, customer experience, pricing, inventory, marketing and business finances.

facts.Current degree: ITI Hair & Skin Care / Cosmetology / Beauty

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Complete Class 10 for eligible vocational training; Class 12 can broaden further-study options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: No specific stream is generally required for many beauty-training routes. Commerce can help with accounting and business fundamentals.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Hair care, skincare, makeup, salon operations and entrepreneurship.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Communication, customer service, budgeting, creativity and digital marketing.

rows.text: Foundation in beauty services and salon practice

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: A specific business degree is not generally necessary to own a salon, but practical beauty skills and business-management knowledge are valuable. Check the DGT CTS directory for current trade availability and entry requirements.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Learn hair, skin and beauty-service basics, hygiene, customer consultation and salon workflow.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Develop competence in the services the salon will offer, such as hair styling, facials, makeup or nail care.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Business skills
blocks.text: Practise pricing, bookkeeping, stock control, supplier negotiation, staff scheduling and customer retention.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Launch preparation
blocks.text: Research demand, estimate start-up costs, select services, plan the layout and prepare a business plan.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Salon service menu and price list • Monthly expense and cash-flow sheet • Customer booking and feedback register • Sample social-media marketing campaign.

blocks.label: Government / training
blocks.text: ITI practical workshops and recognized Beauty & Wellness training providers.

blocks.label: Private
blocks.text: Established salons, spas, bridal studios, cosmetology academies and salon chains.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Service delivery • Hygiene and sanitation • Customer consultations • Inventory and appointment management.
Work in an established salon before launching, if possible. It helps build technical confidence and a realistic understanding of operating costs. Placements are not guaranteed.

items: Home-based services or a small studio
blocks.label: Business route
Alternative route
blocks.text: Gain experience as a salon receptionist, service coordinator or assistant manager before taking responsibility for business operations.

blocks.label: Specialized route
blocks.text: Develop a niche in bridal services, hair colouring, skincare or makeup, then build a salon around customer demand.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Indian training routes
blocks.text: DGT-affiliated ITIs, recognized Beauty & Wellness training providers, established salon academies and entrepreneurship-development programs. Confirm current course recognition and practical hours before enrolment.

blocks.label: Typical pathway

blocks.text: Opening a salon abroad may require local business registration, tax compliance, permits, insurance and sufficient capital. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.
For India, Udyam Registration is the official MSME registration portal; registration is free and does not itself guarantee funding or approvals.

Student ↓ Cosmetology / Beauty Trainee ↓ Salon Assistant / Beautician ↓ Experienced Beauty Professional ↓ Senior Beautician / Salon Supervisor ↓ Salon Manager ↓ Salon Owner ↓ Multi-Outlet Owner / Beauty Entrepreneur

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ ITI COSMETOLOGY OR RECOGNIZED BEAUTY COURSE ↓ PRACTICAL SKILLS + SALON EXPERIENCE ↓ BUSINESS, PRICING + CUSTOMER-SERVICE SKILLS ↓ MARKET RESEARCH + BUSINESS PLAN ↓ FINANCING + APPLICABLE REGISTRATIONS ↓ LAUNCH SALON + BUILD CUSTOMER BASE ↓ EXPAND SERVICES / STAFF / OUTLETS

Verify current official notifications for admissions, scholarships, finance schemes and business requirements. Start with a realistic budget, consistent service quality, hygienic practices and a clear understanding of local customer demand.
